name: Hand-carved Odisha soapstone Ganesha idol, approx. 6 in (wedding / housewarming gift)
supplier_cost_note: No usable supplier price (WebSearch 2026-11-11). The Stone Studio (Khordha, Odisha) shows a 12-in soapstone Ganesha at Rs 190.44 per piece, MOQ 1, on GlobalLinker, but the same seller lists an 8-in stone Ganesh at Rs 14,800 on IndiaMART, so the Rs 190.44 figure looks like a data error or different basis and is NOT used. Gonasika Exim (Bhubaneswar) lists a Ganapati statue, price on request. Owner to get a quote for a 6-in piece incl. protective packing.
retail_observed: indiahandmade.com (seen 2026-11-11 via search snippet): hand-carved stone Ganesha 4 in Rs 5,500 (Braja Kalakruti); hand-carved white stone Ganesha 6x5 in Rs 3,500 (Sri Raja Stone Carving Centre; stone type not stated as soapstone). Rs 1,499 is a placeholder well below these; UNVALIDATED until mass-market (Amazon/Flipkart) prices are checked.

demand_signals.summary: Odisha stone-carving centres retail small hand-carved Ganesha idols at Rs 3,500-5,500. Shows a premium price point; no sales-volume data.

risks: No supplier price: margin cannot be computed
Stone can chip/break in courier (not glass, but breakage returns likely); needs foam/double-box packing, which adds weight and cost
Weight of a 6-in solid stone idol unverified; le_2kg is an assumption, confirm with supplier
Religious item: damage-in-transit complaints are sensitive; product photos must be the actual piece style
Observed retail is artisan-site pricing; mass-market prices may be far lower (not checked this run)
No dated trend signal captured; seasonal (wedding/housewarming) demand is an assumption
